#  File Downloader cookie leak in yt-dlp 

Moderate 

[coletdjnz](/coletdjnz) published GHSA-v8mc-9377-rwjj Jul 6, 2023

## Package

pip youtube-dl ([pip](/advisories?query=ecosystem%3Apip)) 

## Affected versions

>= 2015.01.25

## Patched versions

None

pip youtube-dlc ([pip](/advisories?query=ecosystem%3Apip)) 

All

None

pip yt-dlp ([pip](/advisories?query=ecosystem%3Apip)) 

< 2023.07.06, < nightly 2023.07.06.185519

2023.07.06, nightly 2023.07.06.185519

## Description

### Impact

During file downloads, yt-dlp or the external downloaders that yt-dlp employs may leak cookies on HTTP redirects to a different host, or leak them when the host for download fragments differs from their parent manifest's host.

This vulnerable behavior is present in all versions of [youtube-dl](https://github.com/ytdl-org/youtube-dl), [youtube-dlc](https://github.com/blackjack4494/yt-dlc) and [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp) released since 2015.01.25. All native and external downloaders are affected, except for `curl` and `httpie` (httpie version 3.1.0 or later).

At the file download stage, all cookies are passed by yt-dlp to the file downloader as a `Cookie` header, thereby losing their scope. This also occurs in yt-dlp's info JSON output, which may be used by external tools. As a result, the downloader or external tool may indiscriminately send cookies with requests to domains or paths for which the cookies are not scoped.

An example of a potential attack scenario exploiting this vulnerability:

  1. an attacker has crafted a malicious website with an embedded URL designed to be detected by yt-dlp as a video download. This embedded URL has the domain of a trusted site that the user has loaded cookies for, and conducts an [unvalidated redirect](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Unvalidated_Redirects_and_Forwards_Cheat_Sheet.html) to a target URL.
  2. yt-dlp extracts this URL and calculates a `Cookie` header based on its domain for the file downloader to make its request(s) with.
  3. the download URL redirects to a server controlled by the attacker, to which yt-dlp forwards the user's sensitive cookie information.



### Patches

yt-dlp version 2023.07.06 fixes this issue by doing the following:

  * Remove the `Cookie` header upon HTTP redirects
  * Have native downloaders calculate their own `Cookie` header from the cookiejar
  * Utilize external downloaders' built-in support for cookies instead of passing them as header arguments
  * If the external downloader does not have proper cookie support, then disable HTTP redirection (`axel` only)
  * Process cookies passed as HTTP headers to limit their scope (`--add-header "Cookie:..."` is scoped to input URL domain only)
  * Store cookies in a separate `cookies` field of the info dict instead of `http_headers` so as not to lose their scope



Patches for youtube-dl are expected and we will update this advisory when they are merged.

### Workarounds

It is recommended to upgrade yt-dlp to version 2023.07.06 as soon as possible.

For users who are not able to upgrade:

  * Avoid using cookies and user authentication methods (`--cookies`, `--cookies-from-browser`, `--username`, `--password`, `--netrc`). While extractors may set custom cookies, these usually do not contain sensitive information.
  * Avoid using `--load-info-json`



Or, if authentication is a must:

  * Verify the integrity of download links from unknown sources in browser (including redirects) before passing them to yt-dlp
  * Use `curl` as external downloader, since it is not impacted (`--downloader curl`)
  * Avoid fragmented formats such as HLS/m3u8, DASH/mpd and ISM (use `-f "(bv*+ba/b)[protocol~='^https?$']"`)

#  CVSS v3 base metrics 

Attack vector: More severe the more the remote (logically and physically) an attacker can be in order to exploit the vulnerability.

Attack complexity: More severe for the least complex attacks.

Privileges required: More severe if no privileges are required.

User interaction: More severe when no user interaction is required.

Scope: More severe when a scope change occurs, e.g. one vulnerable component impacts resources in components beyond its security scope.

Confidentiality: More severe when loss of data confidentiality is highest, measuring the level of data access available to an unauthorized user.

Integrity: More severe when loss of data integrity is the highest, measuring the consequence of data modification possible by an unauthorized user.

Availability: More severe when the loss of impacted component availability is highest.

#  Dependency on potentially malicious third-party code in Douyu extractors 

Low 

[bashonly](/bashonly) published GHSA-3v33-3wmw-3785 Jul 7, 2024

## Package

pip yt-dlp ([pip](/advisories?query=ecosystem%3Apip)) 

## Affected versions

2023.09.24 - 2024.07.02

## Patched versions

2024.07.07

## Description

### Impact

yt-dlp's DouyuTV and DouyuShow extractors used a `cdn.bootcdn.net` URL as a fallback for fetching a component of the crypto-js JavaScript library. When the Douyu extractor is used, yt-dlp extracts this JavaScript code and attempts to execute it externally using [PhantomJS](https://github.com/ariya/phantomjs). `bootcdn.net` is owned by the bad actor responsible for the [Polyfill JS supply chain attack](https://sansec.io/research/polyfill-supply-chain-attack) that has been ongoing since at least June 2023. While there is no evidence that PhantomJS has been targeted by or is vulnerable to any attacks carried out by the Polyfill JS actor, there is the possibility that malicious JavaScript code may have been downloaded/cached by yt-dlp or executed by PhantomJS.

In order for this potential vulnerability to be exploited by any hypothetical attack, all 3 of the following conditions must be met:

  1. The user has PhantomJS installed on their system.
  2. The user passes a `douyu.com` or `douyutv.com` URL to yt-dlp as input, or passes a URL that redirects to one of these domains.
  3. `cdnjs.cloudflare.com` is unavailable or blocked at the time of extraction, necessitating the usage of the `cdn.bootcdn.net` fallback; or it had been unavailable during a previous run of the Douyu extractor and JavaScript code from `cdn.bootcdn.net` had been cached to disk.



### Patches

yt-dlp version 2024.07.07 fixes this issue by removing the URL pointing to the malicious CDN and by invalidating any Douyu extractor cache data created by unpatched versions of yt-dlp.

### Workarounds

It is recommended to upgrade yt-dlp to version 2024.07.07 as soon as possible.

For users not able to upgrade:

  * Avoid using the Douyu extractors (`--ies default,-douyutv,-douyushow`)
  * Uninstall (or do not install) PhantomJS



### Acknowledgement

Thanks to [@LeSuisse](https://github.com/LeSuisse) for [reporting this](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/10347) promptly after `bootcdn.net` was discovered to be under control of the same bad actor behind the `polyfill.io` supply chain attack.

### References

  * [`6075a02`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/commit/6075a029dba70a89675ae1250e7cdfd91f0eba41)
  * <https://sansec.io/research/polyfill-supply-chain-attack>



### Severity

Low 

### CVE ID

No known CVE 

### Weaknesses

Weakness CWE-1395

####  [Dependency on Vulnerable Third-Party Component](/advisories?query=cwe%3A1395)

The product has a dependency on a third-party component that contains one or more known vulnerabilities.  [Learn more on MITRE.](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1395.html)

  * [](/LeSuisse) [ LeSuisse](/LeSuisse) Reporter

#  File system modification and RCE through improper file-extension sanitization 

High 

[bashonly](/bashonly) published GHSA-79w7-vh3h-8g4j Jul 1, 2024

## Package

pip yt-dlp ([pip](/advisories?query=ecosystem%3Apip)) 

## Affected versions

<2024.07.01

## Patched versions

2024.07.01

## Description

### Summary

`yt-dlp` does not limit the extensions of downloaded files, which could lead to arbitrary filenames being created in the download folder (and path traversal on Windows). Since `yt-dlp` also reads config from the working directory (and on Windows executables will be executed from the yt-dlp directory) this could lead to arbitrary code being executed.

### Patches

`yt-dlp` version 2024.07.01 fixes this issue by whitelisting the allowed extensions.  
This means some very uncommon extensions might not get downloaded; however, it will also limit the possible exploitation surface.

### Workarounds

It is recommended to upgrade yt-dlp to version 2024.07.01 as soon as possible, **always** have `.%(ext)s` at the end of the output template, and make sure you trust the websites that you are downloading from. Also, make sure to never download to a directory within PATH or other sensitive locations like your user directory, `system32`, or other binaries locations.

For users not able to upgrade:

  * Make sure the extension of the media to download is a common video/audio/sub/... one
  * Try to avoid the generic extractor (`--ies default,-generic`)
  * Keep the default output template (`-o "%(title)s [%(id)s].%(ext)s`)
  * Omit any of the subtitle options (`--write-subs`, `--write-auto-subs`, `--all-subs`, `--write-srt`)
  * Use `--ignore-config --config-location ...` to not load config from common locations



### Details

One potential exploitation might look like this:

From a mimetype we do not know, we default to trimming the leading bit and using the remainder. Given a webpage that contains
    
    
    <script type="application/ld+json">
    {
        "@context": "https://schema.org",
        "@type": "VideoObject",
        "name": "ffmpeg",
        "encodingFormat": "video/exe",
        "contentUrl": "https://example.com/video.mp4"
    }
    </script>

this will try and download a file called `ffmpeg.exe` (`-o "%(title)s.%(ext)s`).  
`ffmpeg.exe` will be searched for in the current directory, and so upon the next run arbitrary code can be executed.

Alternatively, when engineering a file called `yt-dlp.conf` to be created, the config file could contain `--exec ...` and so would also execute arbitrary code.

### Acknowledgement

A big thanks to [@JarLob](https://github.com/JarLob) for independently finding a new application of the same underlying issue.  
More can be read about on the dedicated GitHub Security Lab disclosure here: [Path traversal saving subtitles (GHSL-2024-090)](https://securitylab.github.com/advisories/GHSL-2024-090_yt-dlp)

#  CVSS v3 base metrics 

Attack vector: More severe the more the remote (logically and physically) an attacker can be in order to exploit the vulnerability.

Attack complexity: More severe for the least complex attacks.

Privileges required: More severe if no privileges are required.

User interaction: More severe when no user interaction is required.

Scope: More severe when a scope change occurs, e.g. one vulnerable component impacts resources in components beyond its security scope.

Confidentiality: More severe when loss of data confidentiality is highest, measuring the level of data access available to an unauthorized user.

Integrity: More severe when loss of data integrity is the highest, measuring the consequence of data modification possible by an unauthorized user.

Availability: More severe when the loss of impacted component availability is highest.

## Repository files navigation

This repository contains a sample plugin package for [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme).

See [yt-dlp plugins](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#plugins) for more details.

## Installation

Requires yt-dlp `2023.01.02` or above.

You can install this package with pip:
    
    
    python3 -m pip install -U https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp-sample-plugins/archive/master.zip
    

See [installing yt-dlp plugins](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installing-plugins) for the other methods this plugin package can be installed.

## Development

See the [Plugin Development](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Plugin-Development) section of the yt-dlp wiki.

Automate your workflow from idea to production

GitHub Actions makes it easy to automate all your software workflows, now with world-class CI/CD. Build, test, and deploy your code right from GitHub.

[Learn more about getting started with Actions.](https://docs.github.com/articles/getting-started-with-github-actions)

* * *

#### Linux, macOS, Windows, ARM, and containers

Hosted runners for every major OS make it easy to build and test all your projects. Run directly on a VM or inside a container. Use your own VMs, in the cloud or on-prem, with self-hosted runners.

#### Matrix builds

Save time with matrix workflows that simultaneously test across multiple operating systems and versions of your runtime.

#### Any language

GitHub Actions supports Node.js, Python, Java, Ruby, PHP, Go, Rust, .NET, and more. Build, test, and deploy applications in your language of choice.

#### Live logs

See your workflow run in realtime with color and emoji. It’s one click to copy a link that highlights a specific line number to share a CI/CD failure.

#### Built-in secret store

Automate your software development practices with workflow files embracing the Git flow by codifying it in your repository.

#### Multi-container testing

Test your web service and its DB in your workflow by simply adding some `docker-compose` to your workflow file.

Open

Could you expand the documentation?#7

Copy link

[](https://github.com/fcolecumberri)

## Description

[](https://github.com/fcolecumberri)

[fcolecumberri](https://github.com/fcolecumberri)

opened [on Nov 2, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp-sample-plugins/issues/7#issue-3579706314)

Issue body actions

First of all, thanks for all the effort you have put in this tool, it is awesome.  
I am trying to develop an extractor for a page but I am getting kinda lost here.  
I understand the part that I need to create a class tat inherits from `InfoExtractor` in one of the plugins directories, overload the `_real_extract(self, url)` function.  
I know that I need to find a way to get the info from the page to extract the video URL (which is not the page URL) and to do so I may use the tools that you have develop. However once I arrive to this point I am getting lost.

I don't know if that documentation exists somewhere and I just have not been able to find it and this is the first wall I have hit (in some cases like `_download_json` it gets auto-generated by `__create_download_methods` so it is not even clear what the parameters of the function are). It would be easier to contribute those tools would have some sort of documentation.

Once said that, I know that each webpage is different and that is why the need of different Extractors. However, I assume that there might be a small-ish set of common ideas behind the majority of architectures so it would be nice to have a brief documentation about what to check and where to check it as currently I am a little bit lost checking multiple requests in the `Network Monitor` trying to understand how the front-end and back-end are communicating, but I have not develop web that much and I am sure someone with more experience would have found everything way faster. Because of this, I think creating a playbook would be really useful for people that might cooperate in the future.

Reactions are currently unavailable

  * I'm requesting a site-specific feature

  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates

### Region

Brazil/Indonesia

### Example URLs

<https://ok.ru/video/9987641379464> (Indonesia only, you can use a VPN)

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Seems like the Ok.ru extractor doesn't provide details on if the video is region locked or not.  
The embeds can do this.  
<https://ok.ru/videoembed/9987641379464> (shows a error telling that the video isn't available in your country)  
[https://connect.ok.ru/dk?st.cmd=WidgetContent&st.content=https://ok.ru/video/9987641379464&st.fid=__okContent2&st.hoster=https%3A%2F%2Fapiok.ru%2Fen%2Fext%2Fcontent&st.settings=%7B"topicTextIsFull"%3A1%7D](https://connect.ok.ru/dk?st.cmd=WidgetContent&st.content=https://ok.ru/video/9987641379464&st.fid=__okContent2&st.hoster=https%3A%2F%2Fapiok.ru%2Fen%2Fext%2Fcontent&st.settings=%7B%22topicTextIsFull%22%3A1%7D) (Shows metadata, still can't play the video outside of Indonesia)

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/pukkandan)

[pukkandan](https://github.com/pukkandan)

opened [on May 17, 2022](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766#issue-1238299309)

Issue body actions

Some known common issues. Make sure to always check this before opening issues. **Duplicates of these will be strictly treated as spam!**

**Useful issue tracker filters:**

[[Core Issues]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Aenhancement%2Cbug%2Ccore%3Adownloader%2Ccore%3Apost-processor%2Ccore%3Aextractor%2Ccore%3Anetworking%2Ccore%3Acookies) [[Site Issues]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Asite-request%2Csite-enhancement%2Csite-bug) [[YouTube issues]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Asite%3Ayoutube) [[Good issues for new devs]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22)

## Intractable issues

  * **[[YouTube] This content isn't available, try again later. #11426](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11426)**
    * You are exceeding the rate limit. Refer to [the wiki on how to avoid](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#this-content-isnt-available-try-again-later).
  * **[Passing Youtube cookies doesn't seem to work; cookies are being invalidated quickly #8227](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8227)**
    * [How to effectively export YouTube cookies](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies)
  * **[[youtube] Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot #10128](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10128)**
    * Your IP has been blocked by YouTube while you are logged out. You can [pass logged-in cookies](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies); however, doing so may get your account blocked. The safer solution is to use a different IP.
    * To prevent this, [try passing a PO Token](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/PO-Token-Guide), though it will not help if your IP is already blocked.
  * **[[youtube] "Video unavailable" with cookies - YouTube blocking accounts from web #10085](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10085)**
    * Your account has been blocked by YouTube, or the video is not available in your region.
    * Avoid passing cookies, or add a [sleep delay](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#workarounds) to each download.
  * **[[Youtube] Immediate HTTP Error 403 on download #11868](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11868)**
    * Not to be confused with [[YouTube] "HTTP Error 403: Forbidden" for `ios` m3u8 formats #13511](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/13511), which **is fixed**

# External issues

  * [ffmpeg can't seek in Youtube's iOS m3u8 streams / `--download-sections` only downloads audio #9552](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9552)
    * Use `-S proto:https` or `--extractor-args "youtube:player_client=default,-ios"`
  * [`--cookies-from-browser` "Permission denied" errors when Chrome/chromium-based browser is open in Windows #7271](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7271)
    * Try after closing chrome completely OR
    * Launch chrome from command line w/ `chrome.exe --disable-features=LockProfileCookieDatabase`
    * Alternatively, you can [install](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installing-plugins) the [ChomeCookieUnlock yt-dlp plugin](https://github.com/seproDev/yt-dlp-ChromeCookieUnlock)
  * [`--cookies-from-browser`: WARNING: failed to decrypt with DPAPI / ERROR: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'decode' #10927](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10927)
  * [[youtube] Is downloading a livestream in 1440p or 2160p no longer available? #11262](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11262)
  * [[Youtube] 8k VR180 SBS videos no longer available #9903](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9903)
    * Use `--extractor-arg "youtube:player_client=android_vr,default"`
  * [[Youtube] throttling and inconsistent speed in Russia #10443](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10443)
    * [Workarounds](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10443#issuecomment-2248940967)
  * [[Discord bot] Music stops in the middle #8854](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8854)
  * [[youtube] Endless "Incomplete data received" when downloading playlist #10394](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10394)
    * Don't use `--extractor-retries infinite`
  * [FFMPEG "Invalid data found when processing input" on live/post-live/dash videos (duplicate ftyp) #8641](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8641)
    * Regression in ffmpeg 6.1. Upgrade to ffmpeg 6.1.1 or to [master build](https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds/releases) revision `N-112916` or later
  * [[youtube] "Invalid data found when processing input" / ffmpeg errors on HDR VP9 in mp4 #7541](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7541)
    * ffmpeg bug. Upgrade to ffmpeg 7.0.1 or to the latest [master build](https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds/releases)
  * [`--mark-watched` fails with urlopen error #8149](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8149)
    * Disable pi-hole or whitelist `s.youtube.com`
  * [Chapter Embedding Results in Unnamed Chapters When Using Recent FFmpeg Builds #6859](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/6859)
    * ffmpeg regression. Use <https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds> or upgrade to 6.1.1 or newer
  * [yt-dlp is detected as a virus #25](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/25)
    * It's a false positive. Complain to your vendor. There is nothing we can do
  * [Incomplete Data Recieved #1787](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1787)
    * Broken from Youtube's side. If downloading comments, use `-i` to ignore the error
  * [Wrong year in metadata in M4A, MP4, FLAC format #3087](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3087)
    * Workaround: `--parse-metadata "%(release_year,upload_date).4s:(?P<meta_date>.+)"`
  * [pyinstaller temp files are not cleaned up when using yt-dlp.exe with mpv #10294](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10294)
  * [Long Start-Up Time for `yt-dlp_macos` #10425](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10425)
  * [`--download-sections` / ffmpeg fails to seek in a 26+ hour long Twitch m3u8 #5372](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5372)
  * [Using proxy and `--download-sections`/ ffmpeg fails with HTTP Error 400/401/403 #12915](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12915)



# FAQ

See <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ>

  * **[How to avoid Youtube's new "Super Resolution" AI-upscaled formats #15325](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15325)**
  * **[Getting deno to work in Termux. #15095 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15095#issuecomment-3544324838)**
    * Run a full Termux upgrade with `pkg update && pkg upgrade` before `pkg install deno`
  * **[[Rumble] Unable to download webpage: HTTP Error 403: Forbidden #15089](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15089)**
    * Cloudflare is blocking your IP. Follow [this answer in the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#im-getting-http-error-403-and-the-site-has-an-open-issue-on-the-tracker-thats-labeled-cloudflare-related-what-can-i-do)
  * **[[YouTube] Enhanced bitrate no longer available to download? #14133 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14133#issuecomment-3217679575)**
  * [**Filename too long**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1136#issuecomment-932077195)
    * Use `-o "%(title).150B [%(id)s].%(ext)s"`
  * **[[YouTube]`--write-comments`: "Incomplete data received. Giving up after 3 retries" warnings #15435](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15435)**
  * **[twitter: No video could be found in this tweet #14742](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14742)**
  * [[Question] odd ba* format selection? #979 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/979#issuecomment-919629354)
    * Generally do not use `ba*`
  * [Fix playlist_index's inconsistent behavior #302](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/302)
    * Check `playlist_autonumber` and `--compat-option playlist-index`
  * [yt-dlp python module not compiling with pyinstaller #3845](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3845)
    * Use `bundle/pyinstaller.py`
  * [Subtitle file is not deleted after being embedded #630 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/630#issuecomment-893659460)
    * Use `--compat-option no-keep-subs`
  * [`--download-sections`/`--sponsorblock-remove` does not cut at exact point #4216](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4216) / [YouTube Clip Downloads have unintented extra beginning part with no video #5080](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5080)
    * Use `--force-keyframes-at-cuts`
  * [Duplicating pull request from youtube-dl to yt-dlp #4202](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4202)
  * [How to check in browser if the video is DRM protected](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4062#issuecomment-1153474056)

  * Download only videos with subtitles

# [Announcement] External JavaScript runtime now required for full YouTube support #15012

[New issue](/login?return_to=https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15012)

Copy link

[New issue](/login?return_to=https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15012)

Copy link

Closed

Closed

[Announcement] External JavaScript runtime now required for full YouTube support#15012

Copy link

Labels

[discussion/announcement](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22discussion%2Fannouncement%22)

[](https://github.com/bashonly)

## Description

[](https://github.com/bashonly)

[bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly)

opened [on Nov 12, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15012#issue-3614398875)

Issue body actions

This is a follow-up to [#14404](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14404), which announced that yt-dlp will _soon_ require an external JavaScript runtime (e.g. Deno) in order to fully support downloading from YouTube.

### With the release of [yt-dlp version `2025.11.12`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/tag/2025.11.12), external JavaScript runtime support has arrived.

### All users who intend to use yt-dlp with YouTube are strongly encouraged to install one of the supported JS runtimes.

The following JavaScript runtimes are currently supported (_in order of recommendation, from strongest to weakest_):

  1. ### Deno

     * **recommended for most users**
     * <https://deno.com/>
     * <https://github.com/denoland/deno>
       * note: _if downloading from[Deno's GitHub releases](https://github.com/denoland/deno/releases/latest), get `deno` **not** `denort`_
     * minimum Deno version supported by yt-dlp: `2.0.0`
       * _the latest version of Deno is strongly recommended_
  2. ### Node

     * <https://nodejs.org/>
     * minimum Node version supported by yt-dlp: `20.0.0`
       * _if using Node, the latest version (25+) is strongly recommended for security reasons_
  3. ### QuickJS

     * <https://bellard.org/quickjs/>
     * minimum QuickJS version supported by yt-dlp: `2023-12-9`
       * _if using QuickJS, version`2025-4-26` or later is strongly recommended for performance reasons_
  4. ### QuickJS-ng

     * <https://quickjs-ng.github.io/quickjs/>
     * all versions are supported by yt-dlp; however, **[upstream QuickJS](https://bellard.org/quickjs/) is recommended instead** for performance reasons
  5. ### Bun

     * <https://bun.com/>
     * minimum Bun version supported by yt-dlp: `1.0.31`
       * _if using Bun, the latest version is strongly recommended_



Note that only `deno` is enabled by default; all others are disabled by default for security reasons. See [the EJS wiki page](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS) for more details.

* * *

_In addition to_ the JavaScript runtime, yt-dlp also requires the [yt-dlp-ejs](https://github.com/yt-dlp/ejs) component in order to operate the JS runtime.

**NOTE:** This component **is already included in all of the[official yt-dlp executables](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest)**.  
Similarly, if you've installed & upgraded the yt-dlp Python package with the `default` extra (`yt-dlp[default]`), **then you already have the yt-dlp-ejs component**.

If you've installed yt-dlp another way, then please refer to [section 2 of the EJS wiki page](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS#step-2-install-ejs-challenge-solver-scripts) for more details.

* * *

Support for YouTube without a JavaScript runtime is now considered "deprecated." It does still work somewhat; however, format availability will be limited, and severely so in some cases (e.g. for logged-in users). Format availability without a JS runtime is expected to worsen as time goes on, and this will not be considered a "bug" but rather an inevitability for which there is no solution. It's also expected that, eventually, support for YouTube will not be possible at all without a JS runtime.

* * *

If you have questions, please refer to the EJS wiki page, the previous announcement's FAQ, and the README before commenting or opening a new issue:

  * <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS>
  * [[Announcement] Upcoming new requirements for YouTube downloads #14404](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14404)
  * <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#dependencies>
  * <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#general-options>
  * <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#youtube-ejs>
  * <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS#plugins>



* * *

## Notes to package maintainers

If you are maintaining a downstream package of yt-dlp, we offer the following guidance:

  * The `yt-dlp` repository, source tarball, PyPI source distribution and built distribution (wheel) are still licensed under The Unlicense (public domain); however, **when the`yt-dlp-ejs` package is built, it bundles code licensed under ISC and MIT.** This is the primary reason why `yt-dlp-ejs` was split off into a [separate repository](https://github.com/yt-dlp/ejs) and [PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/yt-dlp-ejs)

  * If `yt-dlp` is packaged as a Python package in your repository, `yt-dlp-ejs` would ideally be packaged separately

  * `yt-dlp-ejs` is technically an _optional_ Python dependency of yt-dlp, but YouTube support is deprecated without it

  * **Each version of`yt-dlp` will be pinned to a specific version of `yt-dlp-ejs` and yt-dlp will reject any other `yt-dlp-ejs` version.** Refer to yt-dlp's [`pyproject.toml`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/2025.11.12/pyproject.toml#L59) for the pinned version

  * If your repository packages `yt-dlp` _as the zipimport binary instead of as a Python package_ , you can use `make yt-dlp-extra` to build the zip executable with `yt-dlp-ejs` included. (The Makefile will look for the `yt-dlp-ejs` wheel in the `build` subdirectory, or the extracted built distribution in the `yt_dlp_ejs` subdirectory)

  * `deno`, `nodejs`, `quickjs` and/or `bun` should be _optional_ dependencies of `yt-dlp`. But again, YouTube support is deprecated without _one_ of them

  * While `yt-dlp-ejs` and the external JavaScript runtimes are currently only used with YouTube, yt-dlp's usage of these may be expanded in the future (and necessarily so)




If this guidance is insufficient, or if you are a developer integrating yt-dlp into your software and you have further questions, please open a [new GitHub issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/new?template=6_question.yml).

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

[bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly)[on Feb 4, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15814#issuecomment-3844634600)

### This is now "fixed" in version [`2026.02.04`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/tag/2026.02.04). Update!

* * *

Player `4e51e895` broke ejs 0.4.0 with these variants:

  * `main` / `es5`
  * `tce`
  * `tcc`



These variants of `4e51e895` do not cause any breakage:

  * `es6`
  * `tv`
  * `tv-es6`
  * `phone`



yt-dlp version `2026.02.04` (via [`1a895c1`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/commit/1a895c18aaaf00f557aa8cbacb21faa638842431)) works around this issue by forcing the `tv` player JS variant.

Support for the broken variants of the latest player versions still needs to be properly added in [ejs](https://github.com/yt-dlp/ejs).

[View full comment ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15814#issuecomment-3844634600)

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Hello,

I would like to ask if it is possible to download subtitles from Instagram Reels/videos using yt-dlp.

What I tested:

\--write-subs

\--write-auto-subs

\--list-subs

But usually I get no subtitles available for Instagram URLs.

My questions:

Does yt-dlp currently support subtitle/caption tracks for Instagram videos?

If Instagram provides auto captions (AI subtitles), can yt-dlp download them?

If not supported, is it because Instagram does not expose subtitle streams separately?

Is there any plan or roadmap to support this?

Example test command:  
yt-dlp --list-subs "INSTAGRAM_URL"

Thank you.

[](https://github.com/Suntooth)

[Suntooth](https://github.com/Suntooth)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

United Kingdom

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Many frequently-aired shows on S4C Clic (such as [Y Deis](https://www.s4c.cymru/clic/series/946763244) or [Rownd a Rownd](https://www.s4c.cymru/clic/programme/947718554)) have generic titles corresponding to the episode's air date as their titles (for example, [4 Chwefror 2026](https://www.s4c.cymru/clic/programme/946763333), which translates to 4 February 2026). YT-DLP doesn't recognise these as titles, and instead outputs the name of the show as the name of the episode (so for the 4 Chwefror 2026 episode, it would output "Y Deis", instead of "4 Chwefror 2026"). However, it _does_ recognise unique titles, such as [Nadolig 2](https://www.s4c.cymru/clic/programme/946763298). I'd like for YT-DLP to output generic titles instead of the show's name on S4C if at all possible, since it really helps with sorting and categorisation.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/MorganVonBrylan)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

France

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I've tested downloading audio from some of the radios that are on YouTube. However the latest versions seem to miss some formats for some reason.  
Example command: `yt-dlp --js-runtimes node --list-formats jfKfPfyJRdk`  
On release **2026.01.29** I get the following output:
    
    
    ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    233 mp4 audio only     │       m3u8  │ audio only        unknown    Default, low
    234 mp4 audio only     │       m3u8  │ audio only        unknown    Default, high
    269 mp4 256x144     15 │  290k m3u8  │ avc1.42C00B  290k video only
    91  mp4 256x144     15 │  290k m3u8  │ avc1.42C00B       mp4a.40.5
    229 mp4 426x240     30 │  546k m3u8  │ avc1.4D4015  546k video only
    92  mp4 426x240     30 │  546k m3u8  │ avc1.4D4015       mp4a.40.5
    230 mp4 640x360     30 │ 1210k m3u8  │ avc1.4D401E 1210k video only
    93  mp4 640x360     30 │ 1210k m3u8  │ avc1.4D401E       mp4a.40.2
    231 mp4 854x480     30 │ 1569k m3u8  │ avc1.4D401F 1569k video only
    94  mp4 854x480     30 │ 1569k m3u8  │ avc1.4D401F       mp4a.40.2
    232 mp4 1280x720    30 │ 2969k m3u8  │ avc1.4D401F 2969k video only
    95  mp4 1280x720    30 │ 2969k m3u8  │ avc1.4D401F       mp4a.40.2
    270 mp4 1920x1080   30 │ 5421k m3u8  │ avc1.640028 5421k video only
    96  mp4 1920x1080   30 │ 5421k m3u8  │ avc1.640028       mp4a.40.2
    

And I can download the audio when using `--format bestaudio`

But on releases **2026.01.31** and **2026.02.04** , I only see these formats:
    
    
    ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    91 mp4 256x144     15 │  290k m3u8  │ avc1.42C00B mp4a.40.5 ANDR-V
    92 mp4 426x240     30 │  546k m3u8  │ avc1.4D4015 mp4a.40.5 ANDR-V
    93 mp4 640x360     30 │ 1210k m3u8  │ avc1.4D401E mp4a.40.2 ANDR-V
    94 mp4 854x480     30 │ 1569k m3u8  │ avc1.4D401F mp4a.40.2 ANDR-V
    95 mp4 1280x720    30 │ 2969k m3u8  │ avc1.4D401F mp4a.40.2 ANDR-V
    96 mp4 1920x1080   30 │ 5421k m3u8  │ avc1.640028 mp4a.40.2 ANDR-V
    

And as expected trying to download the audio gives a "Requested format is not available" error.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm asking a question and **not** reporting a bug or requesting a feature
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar questions **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Please make sure the question is worded well enough to be understood

YT pre-merged formats seems to fail on some videos. For example, format 95 is shown as available with `--list-formats` but fails downloading, meanwhile 136+140 works. Perhaps, is some client the cause?

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a site-specific feature
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

china

### Example URLs

<https://live.bilibili.com/7734200>  
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=THZ8wYeIqv0>

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Try to use the default file name based on the title, and support simplification without date.

[](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/69875121/546381173-baad0174-8387-4a17-8b2f-ba3b538db2e1.jpg?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..Ibac_VNxKoh1LaVTDmW8QeqSfwIGrhDjoIhmEdlVX-I)

Supports more live video format downloads (similar to m3u8 download software)

[](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/69875121/546381501-1e89244e-991c-4b64-9a3c-704c08f3ee67.jpg?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..GmHjQWv5M4-KcM2J4ncFzdz-pmUSNda_37rv7-XjJs8)

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

_No response_

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

yt-dlp is selecting en-US autodub audio format instead of the original language.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Pinned comment options

[bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly)[on Feb 2, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15798#issuecomment-3835809560)

This issue is closely related to [#15756](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15756), and could even be considered the same issue: `android_vr` has a terrible audio format selection.

> Workaround: `--extractor-args "youtube:lang=ja"`
> 
> (replace with whatever language code you want, sadly there's no `original`)
> 
> EDIT: this workaround is preferred to manually selecting formats, because it will allow you to download higher quality audio

Other workarounds, as I originally posted in the linked issue:

>   * [Pass logged-in cookies to yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies) so that you can use the `tv_downgraded` client formats
> 

> 
> OR
> 
>   * Install a [PO token provider plugin](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/PO-Token-Guide#featured-plugins) **and** pass logged-in cookies to yt-dlp **and** use the `web_creator` client (note: if your account is premium, you don't need the …
> 


[View full comment ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15798#issuecomment-3835809560)

## Description

[](https://github.com/richardd89)

[richardd89](https://github.com/richardd89)

opened [on Feb 5, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15835#issue-3899203775)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

United States

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I'm using yt-dlp and `--live-from-start` to download Youtube livestreams as they're live.  
I want it to download both the video and audio simultaneously in case the stream gets taken down/privated/deleted immediately.  
However, I do NOT want the video and audio streams to be merged after the stream ends, as the merging wastes CPU/disk IO for my use case.  
When doing `--live-from-start -f v+a`, both video and audio download live simultaneously, but get merged together after the stream ends.  
When doing `--live-from-start -f v,a` (to avoid merging), the video downloads live, but the audio does not download until after the video is done downloading (when the stream ends). This is not ideal, as the stream may get removed before the audio downloads.

Ideally, `--live-from-start -f v,a` should download both video and audio live simultaneously, but not merge them together after the stream ends.  
Not sure if this is a bug/oversight, or if this is intentional and a different method should be used to download a live livestream w/o merging.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Global

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When downloading YouTube livestream using `--live-from-start`, I noticed that sooner or later the download threads for A/V will crash due to
    
    
    ERROR: Did not get any data blocks
      File "threading.py", line 973, in _bootstrap
      File "threading.py", line 1016, in _bootstrap_inner
      File "threading.py", line 953, in run
      File "concurrent\futures\thread.py", line 83, in _worker
      File "concurrent\futures\thread.py", line 58, in run
      File "yt_dlp\downloader\fragment.py", line 490, in _download_fragment
      File "yt_dlp\downloader\fragment.py", line 462, in download_fragment
      File "yt_dlp\downloader\fragment.py", line 124, in _download_fragment
      File "yt_dlp\downloader\common.py", line 480, in download
      File "yt_dlp\downloader\http.py", line 363, in real_download
      File "yt_dlp\downloader\http.py", line 329, in download
      File "yt_dlp\YoutubeDL.py", line 1154, in report_error
      File "yt_dlp\YoutubeDL.py", line 1082, in trouble
    

And after both threads crashed, the download will stop and a broken, incomplete file is the result, for obvious reason.

This will not happen immediately but given the stream is longer enough (say, >1 hr), it will eventually happen in my 4 times using it lately.

Below is my current download where one of the DL thread already crashed （f140) but not the other (f137), yet.

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Southern Europe

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I've been getting this intermittently yesterday, but today (**Jan 16th 2026** , in my timezone), even when enabling a **supported JS runtime** (**quickjs** in my case), `YouTube` will **refuse to cough up TV-client formats** ; it appears they're now **locking the TV-client behind a logged-in YT account** ; I don't currently have a Google 😡 account to begin with, nor am I inclined to register one with them just for the sake of YT, thus I'm now left with just the `ANDR-S` formats 😞 ~~(and the`WEB-S` ones, when no JS runtime is enabled)~~.

Probably **Google** are rolling out this progressively, as part of an A/B test (?), but I guess I'm being unlucky, as among the first to be affected...

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

_No response_

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

If a SponsorBlock segment lies outside the video duration (which shouldn't be done, but is apparently possible), yt-dlp creates a file that lasts until the beginning (for some reason not end) of that last segment, causing a long freeze frame after the end of the actual video content, then the last bit of the video gets played at the end of the file.

Example: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jBrcBPXUBFw>  
The video is just 3min29sec long, but someone submitted a segment from 9:52.567 to 11:06.564, so yt-dlp makes a video file that is 9min52sec long, with most if it just showing a static image.  
I have already downvoted the segment, so maybe it gets removed before this report is addressed. In that case, it should be possible to test it by creating a segment, manually entering a timestamp and then submitting it to the SponsorBlock testing server.  
When jumping forwards with VLC into the broken part, it jumps right to the last few seconds, so you have to increase speed to go there instead.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

# Deprioritize YouTube "Super Resolution" formats (and other AI-upscaled/AI-modified formats) #15433

[New issue](/login?return_to=https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15433)

Copy link

[New issue](/login?return_to=https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15433)

Copy link

Open

Open

Deprioritize YouTube "Super Resolution" formats (and other AI-upscaled/AI-modified formats)#15433

Copy link

Labels

[enhancementNew feature or request](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22enhancement%22)New feature or request[site:youtube](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22site%3Ayoutube%22)

[](https://github.com/Tiagoquix)

## Description

[](https://github.com/Tiagoquix)

[Tiagoquix](https://github.com/Tiagoquix)

opened [on Dec 29, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15433#issue-3768550920)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

From my understanding, YouTube videos are always downloaded using their original names and audio (e.g. an Arabic video would not be auto-translated at all; not even the video name).

In [#14923 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14923#issuecomment-3539437820), it is said by [@bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly) that de-prioritization may happen in the near future for super resolution formats, which I agree with, since I don't want AI-upscaled slop.

However, I think a better approach would be to not have the format available in the priority queue _at all_. A new cmd-line option could be added such as `--allow-video-upscaling` and `--no-video-upscaling` (the default).

I think it's not possible to have only a upscaled format available, since that would defy logic, so this option shouldn't cause problems.

Maybe a warning could be added when downloading such as:  
`[yt-dlp] Skipping super resolution formats; see the README on GitHub for details`

Thanks.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a site-specific feature
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Worldwide

### Example URLs

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Currently, yt-dlp supports the posts tab, but it doesn't for a single post

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar questions **including closed ones**.   * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Please make sure the question is worded well enough to be understood

When downloading [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PD-MdiUm1_Y) (avc1 codec), `ID 137` (3454k) is chosen instead of `ID 216` (5478k).  
Why is that? Do I have to change something in my preferred sort order?

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

USA

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Recent versions (released in 2026) including the latest version won't list surround sound (ec-3, ac-3 etc.)

Older versions in 2025 lists the surround sound but won't download resulting in error  
ERROR: unable to download video data: HTTP Error 403: Forbidden

If I use smartube to play the youtube video, I can see the surround audio and can play them without issues.  
Link to video  
<https://youtu.be/nK2WNlhKRZk?si=ex1Xkl-mkDQtm_-s>

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Pinned comment options

[bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly)[on Feb 5, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15847#issuecomment-3856979404)

This is a side effect of YouTube changes that have limited which player clients yt-dlp can use to get working formats.

As I've posted in a few different issues (e.g. [#15798](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15798)), here are the known workarounds to improve your formats selection:

>   * Add this to your command: `--extractor-args "youtube:player_client=default,web_embedded"` (thanks [@gamer191](https://github.com/gamer191))
> 

> 
> OR
> 
>   * [Pass logged-in cookies to yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies) so that you can use the `tv_downgraded` client formats
> 

> 
> OR
> 
>   * Install a [PO token provider plugin](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/PO-Token-Guide#featured-plugins) **and** pass logged-in cookies to yt-dlp **and** use the `web_creator` client (note: if your account is premium, you don't need the PO token provider)
> 

> 
> OR
> 
>   * Install a [PO token provider plugin](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/PO-Token-Guide#featured-plugins) **and** use the [experimental SABR branch](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/13515) **…**
> 


[View full comment ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15847#issuecomment-3856979404)

## Description

[](https://github.com/NightCody)

[NightCody](https://github.com/NightCody)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Chile

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Apparently, since version 2026.01.29, not all audio tags 140 for the https protocol appear when the video has multiple audio tracks (however, all audio tracks for the m3u8 protocol do appear).

An example video that's live now and exhibiting this issue is (only the english track language for tag 140 of the https protocol is obtained): <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FkXhKu80CWU>

Previous versions of yt-dlp for this video link works ok and get all audio language tracks for the 140 https protocol

The verbose output for both versions is included below.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

[bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly)[on Jan 29, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15756#issuecomment-3820352727)

Yes, this is an unavoidable side-effect of losing the `android_sdkless` player client's formats. (See this comment for an explanation of why that happened: [#15751 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15751#issuecomment-3819301710))

The new default client that can get HTTPS formats when logged-out, `android_vr`, doesn't yield audio formats for all languages.

There are a few workarounds to getting a better format selection:

  * [Pass logged-in cookies to yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies) so that you can use the `tv_downgraded` client formats



OR

  * Install a [PO token provider plugin](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/PO-Token-Guide#featured-plugins) **and** pass logged-in cookies to yt-dlp **and** use the `web_creator` client (note: if your account is premium, you don't need the PO token provider)



OR

  * Install a [PO token provider plugin](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/PO-Token-Guide#featured-plugins) **and** use the [experimental …](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/13515)



[View full comment ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15756#issuecomment-3820352727)

### Please make sure the question is worded well enough to be understood

i want to lndex my playlist downloads with the first letter of the playlist like a.001  
and can i do this esily for songs that are in a playlist like a.[more than 1 letter index for songs and song fanmakes].001  
i want this to be as easy as possible

  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Example URLs

  * [https://www.youtube.com/@슈삼](https://www.youtube.com/@%EC%8A%88%EC%82%BC)



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When trying to extract the `uploader`, `uploader_id`, and `uploader_url` fields from a video by the user `@슈삼`, I get `NA` as the output, not the data I'm requesting.

This might be because the username uses asian characters, but I've tried with other videos from other users that use those characters and I don't have this problem. (e.g `YBH8N7ZWdHM`, `BxinqUyx40U`)

When I run the command:
    
    
    yt-dlp --print uploader,uploader_id,uploader_url ziJE1deJZDY
    

The output is:
    
    
    superssammu
    NA
    NA
    

yt-dlp version: 2025.11.11.005312

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Global

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Item 1 and 2 in the download playlist has the same link, which is the first video in page 1. The second download is skipped because video is already downloaded. Item 3 download the second video in page 1. The last video in page 1 is ignored because item 30 download the second last video in page 1.

The problem also affects videos in page 2 and next pages. Item 31 and 32 has the same link.

Also using video from user profile doesn't work:  
<https://xhamster.com/users/profiles/braninja/videos>  
I need to remove the 'profiles' for it to work:  
<https://xhamster.com/users/braninja/videos>

yt-dlp.conf:
    
    
    # output
    -o "d/%(extractor_key)s/[%(uploader)s] %(extractor_key)s/[%(uploader)s] %(extractor_key)s %(upload_date)s %(title)s.%(ext)s"
    --windows-filenames
    --trim-filenames 120
    --concurrent-fragments 4
    --no-overwrites
    --write-subs
    --write-auto-subs
    --sub-langs en.*
